items.html: However, through what he sinned, these souls too were flawed, as mentioned above, and there remained in them no illumination except the measure of illumination that was in the aspect of the last Malchuyot of the souls before he sinned. Hence these Ketarim that remained in him have no illumination but the measure of the illumination of the Malchuyot that was at first, before the sin. Therefore it is called the "Nefesh of Adam" — for Malchut is called Nefesh — understand this. And it follows that all the Ketarim remained in him, even the last Keter of them all, which is the Keter of the Sefira of Malchut in the Nukva of Assiya. The general rule that emerges is that all the souls that were included in Adam HaRishon — which are in the ten aforementioned Partzufim, from Zeir of Beria to the Nukva of Assiya — were divided into three aspects, as follows. The first aspect, the highest of all, is called Zihara Ila'a, which was taken from Adam HaRishon; the Klipot did not rule over it at all, God forbid, but it departed from him through the sin that he sinned, and he did not merit it until Chanoch, who is Metatron, came and took it, as is explained by us in Parashat Kedoshim, in the Sitrei Torah, page 83, side B — see there. And it is the aspect of the lights called Yechida, Chaya, Neshama, and Ruach, which are in the Ketarim of each and every Sefira of the ten Sefirot, in each and every Partzuf of the ten aforementioned Partzufim.
